name: Sloper Specialist
flavorText: Everyone else avoids the featureless blob on the wall. You seek it out. Open-hand strength, body tension, and sheer stubbornness let you stick to holds that shouldn't work at all.
villainLine: They think a two-millimeter edge is a jug. You think that's a great way to explode a pulley.
partnerLine: You bring the friction, they bring the finger strength — between you, nothing on the wall is safe.
